restricted_title: Choose the tools for your account
restricted_description: Your account can use buyer tools and the shared resource library. Seller / owner and realtor workspaces require the corresponding account access.

join.title: Join DR Professionals
join.description: Offer property-related services? Create your professional profile, list your specialties and submit it for Admin approval.

Buyer.title: Buyer tools
Buyer.description: Find a property, compare an investment and prepare for your purchase. Your practical tools are here, alongside your saved homes and inquiries.
Buyer.start: Browse homes or rentals, save your favorites, then use the ROI calculator and resource library to prepare questions for your agent. Find approved service providers in the signed-in professional directory.

Owner.title: Seller / owner tools
Owner.description: Manage your property, plan rental income and find help with selling, maintenance and ownership.
Owner.start: Start with your listings and booking calendar. Use the resource library for taxes, permits and utilities, and search the professional directory for legal, design or maintenance support.

Realtor.title: Realtor tools
Realtor.description: Open maps, parcel and title services, organize your clients and find property professionals from one place.
Realtor.start: Open GIS, title and official sources to research a property. The map locates parcels; request the appropriate official certificate and professional review to check current legal status. Leads and pipeline show only information your account is permitted to access.
